evidence.decision: Separates indispensable dependencies from background assets and retains useful cached/partial content instead of blocking every startup.
evidence.artifact: Requires readiness/partial-content policy, asset scheduling and explicit wait resolution alongside the implemented or specified loading states.
evidence.transformation: Catalog example keeps products available during refresh and moves independent preview-video downloads out of the blocking path.
evidence.verification: Exercises slow/offline/partial/refresh/retry/completion and rejects fake values, unresolved waits or unnecessary whole-screen blocking.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies measurable determinate estimates, thematic game loading and brief Watch waits without encouraging prolonged wrist watching.
evidence.handoffs: Launching handles startup and Progress indicators handles measurable work/cancellation only when those stages apply.
evidence.distinctiveness: Dependency scheduling and preservation of real content distinguish this from merely adding a spinner.
